notes.title: Beat Your Meat: Halloweenies Update
notes.notes:
Halloween is right around the corner! Are you prepared? 

This Halloween we want to celebrate in style! That's why during the Halloween period we're having a Halloween takeover. We've given the level Fifty Shades of Hay a new spooky theme. [b]Introducing Halloweenies[/b]:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/3e1f047d50ca86ea22d1c160ad9849e8b077bd5a.png[/img]

As you can see we've gone for an old monster movie look and feel for this map, we hope you enjoy it!

On top of that we've added several Halloween themed costumes for you to enjoy!

[b]Witch:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/24a8cc3570d548be46d837de015ddfa263213201.png[/img]

[b]Frankenswine:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/feb8e66c5149a6b6b6d685880065c8fee66ac3d4.png[/img]

[b]Headless Horseham:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/509684cf71275a8145a4e94adff0afb5c4a07097.png[/img]
With more coming during October!

All of this content will go live at 6pm GMT alongside our newest game mode...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/9a1fae9bf6ac91bba2d83fc20342d9b8690455f6.png[/img]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=je_VrCfufHw

Sausage Party is all about collecting as many sausages as possible! Grab a sausage and bring it back to your corner, but be careful as if you get hit you'll drop your sausage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/7ad871ebd3d798785d8eec8a88a7ecff0539c2cc.png[/img]

We've also piled on bug fixes, tweaks and alterations to make the game more enjoyable than ever. Hopefully you enjoy this update! Let us know what you think over on the Beat Your Meat Community Discord!
[url=https://discord.gg/bprYfVj][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34327477/57c7e97ef09016244673bd34d2f0274cb1cc20f5.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Beat Your Meat Patch 2 06/08/19 New Pork City
notes.notes:
New Level:
[list]
[*]New Pork City: Battle it out on a rooftop! Watch out for the meatball
[/list]

Various Fixes and Changes:
[list]
[*] Fixed Clipping Issues with some customisation options
[*] Added Join/Ready up prompts to the player selection screen
[*] Added a between round leaderboard
[*] Fixed Player Spawning issues in player selection screne
[*] Fixes to more controller issues
[*] Added Round selection
[*] Fixed issue where football wouldn't respawn correctly
[*] Fixed various map issues causing players/objects to fall through the floor
[*] Added new customisation options including Beanie, Eye Patch and Football gear
[*] Various animation changes and tweaks

notes.title: Beat Your Meat Patch 1 25/06/19
notes.notes:
Fixes for various issues with controller support:

[list]
[*] All connected controllers have control over main menu and options menu.
[*] Fixed issues causing non possessed pigs to spawn in main game.
[*] Fixed issues causing controllers to not correctly connect in menu.
[*] Fixed Meat Magnet powerup not correctly facing objects it connects to.
[*] Fixed Meat Magnet sound effects continuing after powerup ends.
[*] Fixed Heavy Meatal not playing animation.
[*] Fixed issues where Juggerpork crown could escape map bounds.
[*] A whole host of other issues with controllers not connecting or ID's swapping leading to mixed names colour or customisation between games
[*] Names not being correctly returned to names list causing missing names or weighting towards specific names.
[*] Many More....
[/list]

To help find more bugs we've now opened #bug-reporting on the Beat Your Meat Discord, if you come across any issues feel free to drop them there. 

[url=https://discord.gg/bprYfVj]Discord Link[/url]

-Fox Byte Games

notes.title: Update 4: Whats next?
notes.notes:
Greetings Piglets!

Its time for another Beat Your Meat update, I wanted to jot down where we are currently. 
If you've picked up Beat Your Meat, you have no doubt come into some controller issues. Rest assured we're getting those fixed. In fact at time of writing I'm making a build to test and ensure we've ironed out the kinks. 

After that we'll be back on the first content release. This first full update will contain a new map and more! Watch this space for news!

Thank you for reading,
The Fox Byte Team

notes.title: Update 3: The New Official Early Access Launch
notes.notes:
Good afternoon Piglets & Porkers.

Welcome to another Beat Your Meat community update! As you may or may not have noticed Beat Your Meat did go live earlier today, This was following some build issues that needed to be fixed, preventing us from releasing last Friday.

However that's all in the past now, and we are go! Grab yourself a tenderiser and get to pummelling! 

I also wanted to take some time to explain what we're going to do during early access.

The primary thing is [b]ONLINE MULTIPLAYER![/b] This is far and away one of the most requested features we've had and its always been something that we want to do. So rest assured that this is coming! The current plan is to get going with this while we're in early access. 
The completion of online multiplayer will mark the end of our early access run. 

That will be before the end of 2019. 

During that time we will be posting regular updates as well. Keep an eye out for new maps, game modes, power ups and more as we make our way through early access. 

These will be done on a monthly basis. Look forward to news on the first one soon.

If you have any burning questions/suggestions/feedback or support going forward, you're more than welcome to join us on the Beat Your Meat discord:
https://discord.gg/bprYfVj

Thanks for reading and enjoy!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34327477/31c862c19721966afb81f2b586de90a42e874068.gif[/img]

notes.title: Update 2: Cetis Porci Me
notes.notes:
Welcome to this weeks Beat Your Meat blog post!

This week I'll be talking about the new announcement trailer for Cetis Porci Me! 
For those that haven't seen the trailer [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7fGwIUK9FAI]check it out here[/url]

Cetis Porci Me will be available with the early access release of Beat Your Meat. As I'm sure you can tell its a Colosseum themed arena, and as such there will be customisation options for the pigs that reflect this!

 Each level in Beat Your Meat will follow a theme of some kind. These themes will be reflected in the level hazards. Yes level hazards! 

Hazards are random events that take place during a game, they're events that will aim to mix up the game in some way. Each one is different so knowing what a level might throw at you is always helpful. 

That's everything for this update.

notes.title: Update 1: Discord And More!
notes.notes:
[b]Welcome![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34327477/db4c0d91d5cc160074b2f69023799c65bdab0c5c.gif[/img]

Thank you for coming and checking out Beat Your Meat! I'd like to start by explaining exactly what Beat Your Meat is and how it works. 

Beat Your Meat is an arena combat game. You take the role of a bipedal pig wielding a meat tenderiser, the aim of the base game mode "Fattest Pig" is the pummel each other and collect the delicious pork products that fall off your opponents. Eating this meat will make you grow big and strong, getting hit will cause you to shrink. At the end of the timer the biggest pig wins!

To aid in the cause powerups can be used to enhance your skills or weaken your enemies! But watch out for hazards in the map as well.

There are other game modes coming to Beat Your Meat as well I'll explain more about them in a future post!

I'd also like to take a moment to mention the discord, we set this up so that you can ask us questions about anything to do with Beat Your Meat and being an indie developer. We're taking suggestions on other things we can do there too. You can check that out here:

[url=https://discord.gg/bprYfVj] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34327477/177bf63ff37d1761021459c4ca47f6c90b7d191e.png[/img][/url]

That's all for this post. Until next time!
